description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista comercial jr. - salvador/ba em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Responsável por apoiar as atividades da equipe comercial, analisar dados de vendas e mercado, e auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios. Acompanhamento de processos de venda, e suporte à equipe de vendas. 

Análise de Dados: Acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho de vendas e análise de tendências de mercado.  Elaboração de relatórios e apresentações para subsidiar a tomada de decisão.  Análise de dados de clientes e comportamento de compra. 

Suporte à Equipe de Vendas: Elaboração de orçamentos e suporte na negociação com clientes.  Preparo de material de apoio para a equipe de vendas.  Atendimento aos clientes e esclarecimento de dúvidas.  Entre outras atividades inerentes a vaga.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS

Experiência: Experiência no varejo.  Experiência na área administrativa comercial. 

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

Formação: Graduação completa ou cursando em áreas como Administração, Marketing, Economia, Comércio Exterior, Logística, ou áreas correlatas. 

Conhecimentos e Habilidades: Conhecimento em técnicas de negociação e vendas.  Excel intermediário ou avançado.  Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.  Habilidade em elaboração de propostas comerciais e apresentações para clientes.  Habilidade em análise de dados e gestão comercial.  Interpretação analítica de dados.  Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.  Proatividade, senso de urgência e organização. 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Benefícios: VA + VT + PL+ Plano Odontologico Unimed + Gympass + Day off

Nossa História ( Lojas Guaibim e Casa+Fácil)

Sobre as Lojas Guaibim:

Com DNA 100% baiano , somos uma empresa nascida em Valença, interior da Bahia, especializada em Varejo de Eletrodomésticos, Eletrônicos, Telefonia Celular, Móveis, Ar Condicionado, Ventilação e Utilidades para o Lar.

Em 20 de março de 1982 iniciamos a nossa caminhada com a abertura da primeira loja em Valença . Depois de 14 anos abrimos mais uma loja em Ituberá, e foi em 2003 que de forma mais intensa, ampliamos nossa rede, a partir da nova loja de Gandú. De lá para cá crescemos ano a ano de forma consistente e sustentável.

Hoje já passamos de 60 canais de venda , entre o interior e a capital Salvador, em alguns bairros e nos principais Shoppings, além das vendas online através de site próprio e marketplaces, entregando para todo o Brasil , com uma frota própria de 25 caminhões, parceria com grandes transportadoras e o Centro de Distribuição que é um dos mais modernos da Bahia com mais de 30 mil metros quadrados.

Temos o maior estoque da Bahia , para você comprar e levar o seu produto na hora , e uma entrega rápida  para quando for receber seu produto em casa!

Desde o início sempre nos preocupamos com o que o nosso cliente precisava para realizar o sonho da sua casa mobiliada . Pensando nisso, proporcionamos acesso ao crédito, já naquela época, para a compra de móveis e eletrodomésticos, o que além de facilitar aos nossos clientes se unindo a preocupação com o melhor atendimento, foi o motivo da nossa consolidação.

O nosso Crediário se tornou referência e é o mais barato da Bahia  (o que temos muito orgulho). Além disso disponibilizamos o maior parcelamento em até 18 vezes em todos os cartões , preservando o nosso compromisso de entregar facilidade, a você, nosso cliente.

Sempre atuando com as melhores marca do mercado como MIDEA, PHILCO, BRITÂNIA, CONSUL, BRASTEMP, ELECTROLUX, LG ELETRONICS, AMVOX, MOTOROLA, SAMSUNG, ORTOBOM, GREE, MOVAL, e muitos outros grandes parceiros que entregam a melhor qualidade e o melhor atendimento.

Então fique à vontade em nosso site e para visitar as nossas lojas físicas. Como bons baianos e baianas, estamos prontos para lhe dar um atendimento caloroso e lhe ajudar nas suas compras. Ah! Siga a gente lá nas redes sociais para ficar por dentro das nossas novidades e ofertas, além de um conteúdo bem da terra do dendê.

Sobre a Casa + Fácil:

Com mais de 45 anos  de atuação no mercado e DNA 100% baiano , a Casa+Fácil  conquistou seu espaço e expandiu no mercado de materiais de construção sendo hoje a maior rede deste segmento na Bahia.

Ao longo dos anos aprendemos que mais difícil do que alcançar a excelência é mantê-la. Por isso, entendemos que nosso objetivo não é conquistar o sucesso, isso é uma consequência de nosso esforço diário. O que colocamos em primeiro lugar sempre é possibilitar e auxiliar na realização dos sonhos e conquistas dos nossos clientes, que são o centro do nosso negócio.

Tudo começou em 13 de agosto de 1972  com uma pequena loja chamada Casa do Fazendeiro , onde comercializávamos produtos para as fazendas na região de Valença - BA.

No ano de 1985  decidimos embarcar em um novo desafio: A venda de materiais para construção. Graças a confiança depositada por nossos fiéis clientes, ampliamos nossa rede e novas filiais foram fundadas.

Em 13 de Novembro de 2000 , passamos a nos chamar Casa & Fazenda , encarando novos desafios, oferecendo aos nossos clientes os melhores produtos e as melhores marcas do mercado, garantindo o nosso crescimento e a satisfação de todas as famílias que sempre confiaram no nosso trabalho.

Com o tempo construímos sonhos de milhares de pessoas, e a identidade de loja que facilita crédito para todos se fortaleceu. Desta forma, nós não tivemos medo de arriscar mais uma vez e em 01 de Abril de 2012  nos reinventamos como Casa+Fácil , trazendo um novo conceito e novas estratégias.

Mudamos muita coisa durante esse tempo...

Afinal são:

+ de 45 anos de história; + de 2 milhões de clientes; + de 20 lojas espalhadas por todo estado da Bahia; + de 3.000 produtos; + Prazo! Aqui você pode parcelar em até 12 X SEM JUROS em todos os cartões.  Crediário + barato da Bahia; + de 10.000m² de Centro de Distribuição;  + Comodidade;

Mas o que nunca mudou é a nossa vontade de construir sonhos e oferecer facilidade para Construir, Reformar e Decorar! Venha fazer parte do grupo que mais cresce na Bahia! Confira abaixo as oportunidades que o Grupo Ramiro Campelo tem para você:

title: Comprador
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Comprador em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um Comprador! Essa pessoa será responsável por gerenciar o processo de aquisição de todos os insumos necessários para a operação do restaurante, garantindo que os produtos estejam disponíveis dentro dos padrões de qualidade exigidos, com preços competitivos e entregues dentro do prazo. O foco será manter a eficiência nas compras, otimizar os custos e garantir a continuidade do fornecimento de produtos essenciais para o funcionamento do restaurante.
Responsabilidades:
- Realizar a compra de todos os insumos e matérias-primas necessárias para a operação do restaurante (carne, pães, vegetais, condimentos, entre outros).
- Negociar com fornecedores e garantir o melhor custo-benefício, sempre mantendo a qualidade dos produtos.
- Monitorar o estoque para evitar excessos ou faltas de produtos, garantindo o fluxo contínuo de produção.
- Controlar e manter registros das compras realizadas, garantindo a conformidade com os orçamentos estabelecidos.
- Avaliar o desempenho dos fornecedores e buscar alternativas para melhorar a qualidade dos produtos e o tempo de entrega.
- Acompanhar e controlar os prazos de entrega e coordenar com a equipe operacional para evitar interrupções.
- Propor alternativas de fornecedores e produtos quando necessário, com foco em inovação e melhorias contínuas.
- Gerenciar as negociações de contratos de fornecimento e estabelecer uma relação sólida com os parceiros comerciais.
- Realizar o controle financeiro das compras, emitindo relatórios de custos e mantendo o orçamento de compras dentro dos limites estabelecidos.

Requisitos:
- Ensino médio completo (superior em Administração, Comércio, Logística ou áreas afins será um diferencial).
- Experiência prévia na área de compras, preferencialmente no ramo alimentício ou de restaurantes.
- Conhecimento básico em controle de estoque e gestão de fornecedores.
- Facilidade com negociação e comunicação eficaz.
- Habilidade para trabalhar com metas e prazos estabelecidos.
- Conhecimento em pacote Office (principalmente Excel) e sistemas de gestão de compras.
- Organizado(a), proativo(a) e com boa capacidade de resolução de problemas.
- Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis e em finais de semana, se necessário.
Habilidades e Competências:
- Negociação: Capacidade de estabelecer boas parcerias com fornecedores e conseguir os melhores preços e condições de pagamento.
- Gestão de Estoques: Habilidade para gerenciar os estoques de forma eficiente, evitando desperdícios e garantindo que os insumos estejam sempre disponíveis.
- Visão Analítica: Capacidade de analisar custos e fazer projeções para otimizar o orçamento de compras.
- Comunicação: Boa comunicação com fornecedores e equipe interna, para garantir o bom andamento dos processos.
- Organização e Planejamento: Capacidade de planejar as compras de maneira estratégica, alinhando os interesses da operação com o orçamento da empresa.
- Iniciativa e Proatividade: Buscar sempre formas de otimizar processos e reduzir custos, apresentando soluções criativas quando necessário.

Salário fixo + bonificações por metas atingidas; Vale transporte; Vale refeição; Vale alimentação; Assistência médica; Assistência odontológica; Parceria de desconto com a Zenklub – (plataforma online de saúde emocional); Day Off – (uma folga no mês do aniversário); Parcerias educacionais com universidades e cursos de idiomas; Seguro de Vida.

Imagine fazer parte de uma equipe que busca no dia a dia inspirar por meio do exemplo e tem o propósito de proporcionar bem-estar, transformando a vida de colaboradores e clientes.

title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical recruiter (remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Reboot Monkey

Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide.

We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

About the Role

Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.

As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try.

This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT or managed DCTs directly . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management. What You'll Do

Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region

Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords

Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score

Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history

Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria

Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training

Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team

Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region

Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them

Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings

Requirements

3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)

Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills

Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring

Fluent written and spoken English

Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision

Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

title: Project manager #1008790
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager #1008790 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Quem Somos A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.
Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.
O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?
Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.
Nosso Cliente Estamos em busca de um profissional em projetos de TI que deverá impulsionar a excelência na execução dos projetos, manter o controle sobre escopo, cronograma e orçamento, além de assegurar entregas de alta qualidade em todas as frentes. Esta função será responsável por supervisionar a entrega ponta a ponta
de quatro novos mód ulos voltados ao suporte das capacidades de Compras (Procurement), garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio, equipes de TI e uma organização terceirizada de desenvolvimento. O candidato selecionado fará parte de
um projeto global em uma empresa multinacional do setor de eletrodomést i cos.
O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:
Gestão do Programa e Supervisão das Entregas (Program & Delivery Oversight) Será responsável pela entrega geral do roadmap dos módulos do Supplier Portal (4 subprojetos), gerenciando cronograma, orçamento, escopo e acompanhamento de marcos (milestones) em nível de programa. Também deverá manter controle rigoroso sobre a definição de escopo, gestão de mudanças e dependências entre projetos e sistemas, além de supervisionar o desempenho do Delivery Manager e da equipe terceirizada para garantir o cumprimento dos compromissos.
Governança e Comitês Executivos (Governance & Steering) Será responsável por definir e conduzir a estrutura de governança do projeto, liderando reuniões de Comitê Executivo (Steer Co), incluindo reporte de status, gestão de riscos e escalonamentos, além dos fóruns de tomada de decisão. Também deverá fornecer visibilidade e relatórios em nível executivo, assegurando transparência sobre o andamento do programa.
Gestão de Stakeholders e Alinhamento com o Negócio (Stakeholder & Business Alignment) Será responsável pelo relacionamento com stakeholders da área de Compras (Procurement) e com a liderança sênior, garantindo que os requisitos de negócio sejam claramente definidos, aprovados e priorizados. Deverá promover o alinhamento entre a área de Negócios (Procurement), as equipes de TI (MDR, PLM e Integração) e a organização responsável pela entrega, atuando ainda como ponto final de escalonamento para conflitos ou ambiguidades relacionadas ao negócio.
Gestão de Riscos e Problemas (Risk & Issue Management) Deverá identificar proativamente riscos e dependências em nível de programa, garantindo que sejam mitigados de forma antecipada e sistemática. Também será responsável por escalar questões críticas com recomendações claras e análise de impacto.
Controle Financeiro e Planejamento (Financial & Planning Control) Será responsável pelo acompanhamento e previsão orçamentária, garantindo que as entregas permaneçam dentro dos limites financeiros aprovados. Também deverá validar a alocação de recursos em conjunto com o Delivery Manager.
Liderança e Direcionamento (Leadership & Direction) Deverá fornecer direcionamento claro e definição de prioridades ao Delivery Manager, garantindo foco em resultados, cumprimento de prazos e geração de valor para o negócio. Espera-se uma atuação proativa na resolução de ambiguidades e na remoção de impedimentos para acelerar a tomada de decisões e o progresso do programa.
O que você precisa ter:
Inglê s - Avançado (necessário para Experiência como Gerente de Projetos de TI em ambientes complexos e com múltiplas frentes de trabalho simultâneas. Experiência com metodologias ágeis de entrega (Agile). Capacidade de gerenciar equipes de desenvolvimento terceirizadas. Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação. Forte capacidade de organização e definição de prioridades. Habilidade para atuar como ponte entre as necessidades do negócio e a entrega técnica. Perfil altamente proativo e orientado à solução de problemas. Elevada atenção aos detalhes, mantendo ao mesmo tempo uma visão estratégica e abrangente do projeto. Identificar e mitigar riscos de forma antecipada, reduzindo impactos ao programa. Entregar soluções escaláveis e de alta qualidade, alinhadas à estratégia da plataforma Supplier Portal.

title: Lead product designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead product designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we?
Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; Java Script a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Staffing specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who We Are
MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100 Bn+ industry.
What the Platform Team Does at MAVI
Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.
About the Role
We’re hiring a
Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.
What You'll Do
Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles. Serve
as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated. Build strong, long-term relationships
with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs. Support the end-to-end matching process
by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions. Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities. Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers. Provide support throughout the hiring
process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving. Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties. Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.
What We’re Looking For
At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role. Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador financeiro/ planejador patrimonial (pessoa física) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.
Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.
Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!
Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:
O Grupo Capital:
Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.
Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.
Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil.
Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.
Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:
A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.
Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.
Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.
Responsabilidades:
Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.
Pré-requisitos:
Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.
Diferencial:
Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.
Você terá:
Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa de
partnership
estruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.
Modo de contratação:
Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global ta manager (contractor role) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Location:
Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration:
6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation:
Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)
Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only:
Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.
What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery:
Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation:
Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency:
Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.
The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese):
Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages.
You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine:
2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility:
Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.
Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine:
You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails:
You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.
What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential:
On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook:
Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew:
No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.
The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination:
Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity:
Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

title: Senior revops analyst - churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior revops analyst - churn em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Contract Type:
Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:
6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.
About the Role We are seeking
a Senior Rev Ops Analyst - Churn
to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the Rev Ops Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, Rev Ops, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.
Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, Rev Ops, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.
Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or Saa S business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

title: Senior revops analyst - churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior revops analyst - churn em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Contract Type:
Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:
6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.
About the Role We are seeking
a Senior Rev Ops Analyst - Churn
to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the Rev Ops Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, Rev Ops, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.
Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, Rev Ops, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.
Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or Saa S business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

title: Project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

title: Lead product designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead product designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we?
Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; Java Script a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.
You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.
Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.
Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.
Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; Java Script a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Procurement Savings Cost Avoidance Supplier Reliability Lead Time Reduction Margin Improvement Forecast Accuracy Supply Chain Stability
Compensation Competitive Base Salary + Performance Bonus The selected candidate will participate in a Procurement Savings Incentive Program tied directly to measurable value creation through: Supplier negotiations Strategic sourcing Cost reductions Supply chain improvements Margin enhancement initiatives Top performers will have significant earning potential tied to their impact on company profitability.

Fully Remote Position Direct Access to Executive Leadership High Growth Environment Opportunity to Build a World-Class Procurement Department Performance-Based Compensation Work on Landmark Building Envelope Projects Throughout the Northeast U. S.

title: Staffing specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who We Are
MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100 Bn+ industry.
What the Platform Team Does at MAVI
Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.
About the Role
We’re hiring a
Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.
What You'll Do
Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles. Serve
as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated. Build strong, long-term relationships
with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs. Support the end-to-end matching process
by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions. Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities. Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers. Provide support throughout the hiring
process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving. Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties. Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.
What We’re Looking For
At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role. Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment. Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric. High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information. Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change. Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach. Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.
Why You Should Join
Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business. No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness. Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :) Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.
Equal Opportunity Statement

Our client helps organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a
Senior Solution Architect , you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.
Why Join the Solution Architect Team? Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. Help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across our client’s environments. Collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success teams to shape best practices and improve the platform. In This Role, You Will Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for our client’s deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, Dev Ops engineers, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement initiatives for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.
What You’ve Accomplished So Far 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including previous experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/Cent OS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS and GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of Mongo DB or other No SQL databases, including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills, with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and programming using Bash, Python, Java Script, and CSS. Experience with load-testing tools such as K6 and modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query) is a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
How You’ll Ramp Up By Day 30 Build a strong understanding of our client’s architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60 Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities. Troubleshoot escalations and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90 Own complex technical engagements end-to-end. Customer Success Manager at Cloud SEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they
derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve
deep engagement with clients , providing expert
guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of Cloud SEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.

Account Management: Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements. Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement. Operational Excellence: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems. Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.
Ideal candidate: 4-5 years of experience in
Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry. Strong understanding of
cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required. Proven track record of
achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth. Ability to
work independently and manage multiple accounts
simultaneously.
Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills: Business reviews: Onsite meetings Maintaining NRR and GRR Threat analysis and Value delivery

Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of Saa S operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.Experiência com Sistemas title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal.3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the process.4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepancies.5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquiries.6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportunities.
